## Description

Trade as a target fraction of observed market volume, dynamically changing the pace as liquidity changes.

## Where it may fit

Orders without a rigid completion deadline where controlling participation/footprint matters.

## Vehicles

Liquid stocks, ETFs, futures and FX.

## Required data

Parent order, real-time trades/volume or order-book depth, target participation, quotes, volatility and limits.

## Caveats

Can take too long in thin markets and may expose the order to information leakage.
